description: This file defines classes and methods for managing uplink context and its repository in a wireless communication system, including resource grid handling, context copying, writing, and completion checks.

classes.name: uplink_context
classes.description: Represents the uplink resource grid context, including methods for copying, writing, and checking completion status.

classes.name: uplink_context_resource_grid_info
classes.description: Holds information about the resource grid context and shared resource grid.

classes.name: uplink_context_repository
classes.description: Manages storage and access to multiple uplink contexts, supporting concurrent operations and resource grid management.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the uplink context.

methods.name: write_grid
methods.description: Writes IQ data into the resource grid at specified port and resource element start.

methods.name: try_getting_complete_resource_grid
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a complete resource grid if all PRBs are written.

methods.name: pop_uplink_context_resource_grid_info
methods.description: Returns and clears the stored resource grid info.
